name: Yuri Kamanosuke
source:
A member of the Sanada ninjas and a former renowned kabuki samurai.

He forced his way into the famed Sanada house to become Nobushige's subordinate. Straightforward and sincere, he values empathy, loyalty, and friendship. Among the younger three Sanada ninjas, he is the oldest and acts like a big brother. He sets the tone for the group and wields a giant sickle and chain. His small stature belies his great strength.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/homura/chara/?page=kamanosuke]Idea Factory International[/url]]
